name: UM 461 (Hubble)
blurb: UM 461, a tadpole-shaped dwarf galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: um461-hubble
story: UM 461 is a metal-poor dwarf whose star formation is concentrated in one bright head. A drop in metallicity there hints that even more metal-poor gas falling in set off the burst.

claims.text: UM 461 is one of four nearby tadpole galaxies imaged by Hubble
Tadpole galaxies are metal-poor dwarfs with one dominant star-forming region
A metallicity drop in the head suggests accretion of lower-metallicity gas triggered star formation
UM461 is a compact dwarf target of program 15860 on accretion-triggered starbursts in tadpole galaxies
